io.name: clk
io.description: Clock; all D flip-flops trigger on the negative edge.

io.name: reset
io.description: Active high synchronous reset; when high at the negative edge, q is loaded with 0x34.

io.name: d
io.description: Data input to the 8 D flip-flops.

io.name: q
io.description: Registered output of the 8 D flip-flops.

functional_summary.overview: Eight D flip-flops triggered on the negative edge of clk, with active high synchronous reset that loads 0x34 instead of zero.
rules: On each negative edge of clk, if reset is high, q is synchronously loaded with 0x34.
On each negative edge of clk, if reset is low, q is loaded with the current value of d.
q holds its value between negative clock edges.
Reset is synchronous: it only takes effect at the negative edge of clk.
